items.title: ZDI-CAN-27785: claude-hovercraft
items.description: A CVSS score 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Peter Girnus (@gothburz) of Trend Research' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-10-06, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-02-03 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
